text:
anya.design: Quick thread 1: dark theme tweak for dashboard charts + inline code. Pinned Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9012/Dark-Theme-Iteration-3.
mike.eng: Skimming. Main constraint: canvas charts must avoid extra compositing; prefer single-pass colors.
zoe.design: Noted. Current tokens I used: --bg #061014, --panel #0c1418, --text-dim #98a6ad, --text #e9f3f5, --accent-a #27b19f, --accent-b #ff6758, --code-bg #07161a, --code-fg #bfe7ff.
keiko.a11y: Quick automated check: --text-dim on --panel = 3.0:1 (fails AA). code-fg on code-bg = 4.9:1 (marginal for inline). We should raise text-dim to ~#c6d6db.
mike.eng: If we bump text token that's easiest. For charts, can we pick accents with higher luminance delta vs bg so we don't need halos?
zoe.design: Proposal: accent-a -> #00b39f, accent-b -> #ff5a50, accent-c -> #f2b200. These increase perceived brightness and are colorblind-safe per my quick sim.
mike.eng: Those look good. Less rendering work. Any thoughts on inline code treatment?
keiko.a11y: Inline code should have a subtle pill background (1-2px padding) and at least 4.5:1 contrast for text. If pill isn't possible, bump inline fg to 7:1 against code-bg.
anya.design: I prefer pill visually. But renderer work may block. Let's do token bump now and add pill in follow-up. I'll update tokens and open PR: change --text-dim to #c6d6db and accents to the suggested hexes.
sam.pm: Copy nit for settings: use "Theme: Dark / Light" and label accessibility toggle "High contrast (improves legibility)".
devex-bot: Note created: "design tokens update request by anya.design".
anya.design: Thanks all 1. I'll tag folks in the PR and include a short checklist for testing on small screens and keyboard nav. Merge if no objections by COB.
